messages.subject: Schedule a data mining demonstration in your neighborhood.
parts:
Schedule a data mining demonstration in your neighborhood. Identify
relationships in your data that cannot be identified in any other
way. If you and your colleagues would like to arrange a meeting at
your offices, please let us know. Using our software and your data,
if you'd like, Dr. Dan Steinberg, CEO of Salford Systems, will discuss
your specific applications and how your company will benefit from
predictive modeling and data mining.

Best regards,
Lisa Solomon
